propositions: The Cloud rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded rather than derived, so transport modules can be renamed or moved without the completeness assertion catching the drift.
A classified mutating method can be added outside the swept modules without being caught, unless it collides with names already in _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING.
The transport sweep scope should remain explicit (four modules) rather than widening to a package-wide glob that would require classifying 90 unrelated members against the 429 policy.
An anti-drift guard must accept only pure same-name self.transport delegations with unchanged arguments, rejecting guards, retries, logging, argument transforms, or renamed targets.
The two known collisions (backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment) are benign pure facades and must be the only accepted collisions outside the swept set.
A new transport module added alongside the four should be caught as unswept if it defines a classified mutating name that is not a pure facade.
